text:
Aisha: heads-up: customer saw provisional > confirmed after a streaming reconnect + a retried tool call. Sending repro.

Tom: paste request id/traces when you have them.

Aisha: sanitized trace:
```
req=cli-9b7c
events=[start, chunk(88), disconnect, resume(session=s-551), chunk(46), toolcall(start,id=tc-21), toolcall(truncate), retry(toolcall,id=tc-21-r1), end]
provisional_tokens=276
confirmed_tokens=170
```

Ravi: likely cause: the truncated toolcall from the first session is getting a provisional charge, then the retry charges again because origin_session_id is lost during handoff.

Sasha: saw similar in canary. Router handoff to compat variant drops origin_session_id. Ledger can't dedupe without it.

Tom: short-term UX: show per-route "Tentative" badge (hover: "Includes provisional charges pending final ack; may adjust in ~2m"). Cuts support noise.

Ravi: long-term: emit `provisional` flag, `origin_session_id`, and `toolcall_attempt_id` on ledger/telemetry events. Reconcile confirmed charges by matching (origin_session_id, token_end). Add provisional TTL (~2m) to auto-expire if no confirm arrives.

Aisha: good. Also add a debug log when origin_session_id is dropped: `origin_session_dropped=true req=...` to help repros.

Sasha: I'll add a small shim to preserve origin_session_id on handoff (1-2d).

Tom: I'll add an integration test for disconnect->resume->retry flow and the console tooltip copy.

Ravi: I'll draft an RFD for the dedupe rule + telemetry schema change and hold refunds policy until we see rates.

Aisha: TL;DR: preserve origin_session_id, emit provisional + attempt ids, provisional TTL, console badge. Follow-ups assigned. Thanks!
